description: Harden the public LLM authoring, inspection, visual review, and evidence workflow

sprint.goal: Make the supported static asset workflow independently discoverable, safely editable, visually reviewable, and reproducible by a fresh MCP-capable LLM without source knowledge.
sprint.demo_notes: Phases S1 and S2 are owner-approved. Phase S3 automated verification passed: the repository-local workflow skill, exact unavailable-tool ledger, audit-only artifact verifier, three-surface visual review, and paired eval evidence are complete. Owner S3 approval is pending. The sword remains visually weak at native size, accessories remain limited to sword and shield, and fresh MCP execution, portable manifests, temporal animation, sprite atlases, animated GLB, and external import are not yet proven.
